name: Tripwire
source: workspace/marketing/members.json — the ledger the page's copy is built from
how: sha256("wc1|email|" + address.toLowerCase())[0:16] and sha256("wc1|token|" + token)[0:24], both written by `wealthclaw login issue` and checked in the browser by the page's own sha256 (crypto.subtle is HTTPS-only, and this page must also open from disk).
honest: It proves possession of a token, not identity: whoever holds it gets in. The list is published at build time, so a revoke signs someone out on the next hourly build, not on their next refresh. And there is no server, so signing in can tell you what your tier covers — it cannot arm a tripwire or take a card.
fields: id, tier, stack (the chosen trading style — one of the five the tier measured), label (masked), email_sha = sha256("wc1|email|" + address.toLowerCase())[0:16], token_sha = sha256("wc1|token|" + token)[0:24], since, until, state. Check the pair yourself: wealthclaw login whoami --token <token>
